DM_STUDY_IDENTIFIER.evidence: The clinical action requests the DM study identifier, matching STUDYID.

DM_DOMAIN_CONSTANT.evidence: The clinical action requests the constant DM domain code, matching DOMAIN.

DM_UNIQUE_SUBJECT_IDENTIFIER.evidence: The clinical action requests a unique subject identifier derived from study and subject identifiers, matching USUBJID.

DM_INFORMED_CONSENT.evidence: The clinical action requests the informed consent date in ISO 8601 format, matching RFICDTC.

DM_SEX_TERM.evidence: The clinical action requests sex mapped to controlled terminology, matching SEX.

DM_COUNTRY.evidence: The clinical action requests the country value, matching COUNTRY.

AE_STUDY_IDENTIFIER.evidence: Clinical action specifies copying the study identifier to AE; source role is study_identifier.

AE_DOMAIN_CONSTANT.evidence: Clinical action specifies the constant AE domain code; project policy provides AE_DOMAIN_CONSTANT with value AE.

AE_UNIQUE_SUBJECT_IDENTIFIER.evidence: Clinical action specifies deriving the unique subject identifier; project policy defines its study and subject components.

AE_REPORTED_TERM.evidence: Clinical action specifies copying the reported adverse event term; source role is reported_term.

AE_SEVERITY.evidence: Clinical action specifies mapping adverse event severity; AESEV is the target severity/intensity variable with controlled terminology.

AE_START_DATE.evidence: Clinical action specifies converting the adverse event start date to ISO 8601; AESTDTC is the ISO 8601 start date/time variable.

VS_STUDY_IDENTIFIER.evidence: The clinical action explicitly requests the VS study identifier, matching STUDYID.

VS_DOMAIN_CONSTANT.evidence: The clinical action requests the constant VS domain code, matching DOMAIN.

VS_UNIQUE_SUBJECT_IDENTIFIER.evidence: The clinical action explicitly requests derivation of the unique subject identifier, matching USUBJID.

VS_TEST_CODE.evidence: The clinical action requests the vital signs test code, matching VSTESTCD.

VS_ORIGINAL_RESULT.evidence: The clinical action requests the original vital signs result, matching VSORRES.

VS_MEASUREMENT_DATE.evidence: The clinical action requests the vital signs measurement date in ISO 8601 format, matching VSDTC.
